awardPrompts.award-line: Use case: stylized-concept. Production raster celebration artwork for Six Drop, a premium Japanese candy arcade game. One isolated genuinely transparent 1536x1024 landscape game popup. Exquisite hand-painted three-dimensional sugar craftsmanship: thick luminous translucent hard candy, wet glossy highlights, faceted edible crystals, gold sugar filigree, fine sugar grains, rich candy-colored extrusion. This is FINISHED illustrated content and sculpted lettering, not a blank frame. The TITLE itself is a large sculpted edible artwork, centered around y=34%, occupying x=12–88%, y=18–51%. An empty narrow ribbon x=25–75%, y=57–65% is reserved for live Japanese role-count text. Below it, a clean luminous pale cream/sugar-glass space x=19–81%, y=69–85% is reserved for actual payout numerals added by game code; keep this region clear. The amount area is part of a small candy pedestal, not a dark-plum rectangular panel. Artwork stays4%inside canvas edges. No placeholder numbers, no counts, no currency, no watermark, no grid. Outside the complete sculpture alpha transparent, no scenery or checkerboard. Crisp strong silhouette readable at350pxwide. Exact ONLY baked title: 'STRAIGHT!' in a single exuberant sweeping line of thick glossy strawberry-pink candy letters, pale vanilla-white highlights, cranberry-pink inner bevel and gilded rim. Large looping pink sugar ribbons curl behind the letters; a dynamic trail of FOUR same-pink polished round candies runs in a straight rising diagonal behind the top, making a candy comet. At lower outer corners, clusters of rose bonbons, one folded cellophane-wrapped candy each, and spun-sugar spirals. Top-left ribbon arcs naturally through the title; right has a sparkling heart-shaped candy medallion. Deep ruby silk blank live-label ribbon. Lower pedestal is a soft pearl-pink candy shell with tiny sugar pearls and a warm golden base. Open energetic composition, delicious material, not an enclosing border, not symmetrical generic shield, no blank central plaque. All graphic storytelling and lettering are finished.

candyOriginal:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for the existing Six Drop candy arcade game.
Primary request: a visibly new, lavishly rendered set of NINE luscious hard-candy pieces, with rich sculpted sugar-glass interiors and different rounded silhouettes, at the quality of an ornate premium Japanese candy arcade. This must be actual detailed production artwork, not a UI mockup.
Composition: exactly 1536 by 1536 pixels, square. Exactly THREE equal columns and THREE equal rows, nine invisible 512px cells. One isolated candy centered in each cell. Generous transparent separation; every piece occupies 80–84% of its cell in both dimensions. No drawn grid, labels, drop shadows outside the piece, or scene.
Exact color order, reading left to right then top to bottom:
row 1: saturated royal BLUE / clear cyan AQUA / emerald GREEN.
row 2: bright LIME green / golden lemon YELLOW / vivid ORANGE.
row 3: true scarlet RED / vivid strawberry PINK / royal VIOLET.
The red and pink must be clearly different, and blue versus aqua clearly different.
Shapes: blue is a plump rounded hexagonal crystal candy; aqua a rounded six-petal sugar flower; green an eight-facet cushion candy; lime a smoothly rounded diamond sweet; yellow a luscious polished spherical lemon drop; orange a broad soft scalloped round drop; red a thick softly octagonal cherry candy; pink a rounded four-lobed blossom candy; violet a smooth round drop with a sculpted spiral ONLY IN ITS OUTER RIM. All shapes remain full, compact, centered, and contained inside a circular diameter. No narrow points, no holes.
Material: thick translucent hard sugar, extremely convincing rounded depth, saturated light glowing within, crisp white glossy rim reflections, jewel-like refracted edge, delicate rim embossing and ONE tiny edge sparkle. Strong silhouette and depth that remain clear at only 29 pixels. Each candy's CENTRAL 55% is an uncluttered, uniform smoothly colored face suitable for placing a live readable number over it; keep decoration, grooves and glints OUT of this central face.
Constraints: absolutely NO text, digits, letters, labels, symbols, numbers or logos. No cream/star feet, no pedestals, no gold stands, no wrapping paper, no external bow or ribbon. Do not reproduce the former flat circular discs with a cream star foot. No extra objects in the gutters. Front view, no perspective tilt. Genuine transparent alpha background around all nine candies.
payoutOriginal:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent payout-card atlas for a Japanese candy arcade game. Actual finished artwork including sculptural Japanese title lettering and tiny role diagrams; NOT a mockup.
Canvas: 1536 by 640 pixels, transparent. THREE equal vertical cells, each 512 by 640 pixels, one fully drawn card in each third, aligned to exactly the same top and bottom. Cards will display very small at 96 by 109 pixels. Make title letters bold and simple enough to remain readable.
Design: three genuinely DIFFERENT full candy-shop objects, richly rendered front-on with luscious thick hard sugar, glossy reflections, folded candy wrapping, fine engraved edges, carved sculptural Japanese lettering, and gorgeous dimensional detail. NOT three generic rectangular jewel picture frames.
LEFT: pink strawberry twist-wrapped sweet-shaped payout plaque, soft curving sugar edges and little wrapper folds tucked tightly INSIDE its cell. Sculptural pale-cream sugar title with dark plum outline reading EXACTLY 「直線」. Above the title, a tiny distinct diagram of EXACTLY FOUR identical pink circular candies arranged in ONE straight horizontal line with small gaps. No extra candies around that diagram.
MIDDLE: aqua folded-candy-paper pouch with a triangular folded roof and rich turquoise sugar edges. Sculptural pale-cream sugar title with dark plum outline reading EXACTLY 「三角」. Above the title, a tiny distinct diagram of EXACTLY SIX identical aqua candies arranged in THREE rows: ONE centered at the top, TWO centered in the middle, THREE centered at the bottom. Do not draw a seventh candy.
RIGHT: violet translucent hexagonal candy tin, broad body with softly angled top and bottom corners and intricate sugar-glass bevels. Sculptural pale-cream sugar title with dark plum outline reading EXACTLY 「ヘキサゴン」. All five Japanese characters must be intact, bold and clearly legible. Above the title, a distinct diagram of EXACTLY SIX identical violet candies arranged as a hexagonal ring around an EMPTY center, no central candy.
Layout invariants for EACH card: title and its diagram occupy ONLY the UPPER THIRD. Diagram approximately y2%–15%; title approximately y18%–31%. The lower body is a CLEAN, BLANK, DEEP DARK PLUM face for dynamic rows to be added by code: the rectangle from x12% to x88% and y35% to y92% must remain entirely plain, clear and unobstructed. Very thin vertical rims. All ornate folds and accents stay outside that blank rectangle. No horizontal decorative line inside the blank lower body. Give the lower body generous useful area, with subtle painted dimensional shading only.
Only the exact three titles 「直線」「三角」「ヘキサゴン」 may appear. NO digits, NO payout numbers, NO English, NO count labels, NO other Japanese text. No watermarks. No background scenery, no flat beige background. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the three objects and in the gaps.
